summary: 60-foot wooden western tower on Ridley Hill, York County, Maine; the state lost its lease and a 1962 steel tower on Mount Hope replaced it; now listed as gone.

facts.design: 60-foot wooden western tower with live-in cab and catwalk
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no readable source describes the site now

events.note: Ridley Hill lookout reported a fire sighting on the east side of Sanford on July 9, 1949; a resident was found burning rubbish without a permit

notes_for_editor: The build date and any later fate of the wooden Ridley Hill tower are not in the readable sources; the story does not give them. The 1949 entry is a minor fire-sighting report, quoted from a Portland Press Herald item on the Ron Kemnow list, which I did not see directly. HMDB places Ridley Hill in Springvale; the FFLA list gives York County and coordinates 43.48104, -70.84343. The Mount Hope story (us-me-mount-hope) already covers the 1962 move and should stay consistent with this one.
